title: Patch: /stats' Tokens and Other created cards match the deck table, rows open the card, and the page loses its explanatory paragraphs
thread:
**Issue #4155 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #4155: Patch: /stats' Tokens and Other created cards match the deck table, rows open the card, and the page loses its explanatory paragraphs Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. The owner's request: the Tokens and Other created cards sections on `/stats` should look and act almost exactly like the normal cards table. The page should also lose the paragraphs of explanation scattered across it. **This replaces #4083's column list (its point 1).** #4083 drops Win rate and hides Games. The owner wants both kept, as below. #4083's other points (the deck table's sort select, the Grid view, ranges, the API trim) are not part of this issue. ## What to build ### 1. The Created tables' columns match the deck table's In `apps/web/src/stats/CreatedPanel.tsx`, both sections (Tokens and Other created cards) show the deck table's columns, in its order and under its header labels (`apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`, the `stats-table` under `statsTestid.cardsTable`): | Column | As in the deck table | |---|---| | **Card** | the thumbnail cell: the cost badge coloured by rarity (`stats-td--thumb`) | | **Name** | header `Name` (today the Created header reads `Token` / `Card`) | | **Games** | | | **Tier** | the `TierChip` | | **Adjusted** | the adjusted win rate | | **Win rate** | the raw win rate (`createdWinRate`) | - Honour the tab's **Columns** toggle (`visibleCols.thumbnail`, `visibleCols.games`) as the deck table does. Pass it into `CreatedPanel`. - Remove **Used**, **Not used**, **Used Radiant**, **Used normal** and **Used vs not used**, with their sort keys in `CreatedPanel` and any helpers left with no caller (such as `formatPlayedDelta`, if nothing else uses it). - Every remaining header still sorts (R3184002), and each section still opens on Adjusted, best first (R4082000). - Use the deck table's cell markup and classes, so the rows look the same, not merely hold the same figures. Lifting the shared row or header into one component both tables use is welcome. Keep it inside `apps/web/src/stats/`. - The `created` rows of `GET /api/stats/cards` already carry `cost` and `rarity` for the thumbnail. **No server change.** The API trim stays #4083's. ### 2. A row opens the card A Created row opens the same drill-down the deck table's rows open: `openDrillDown(card.id, opener)`, `?card=` in the address, Back and Escape close it (R2127000, R3221000). - The rows act as the deck table's do: `role`/`tabIndex`, Enter and Space, the pointer cursor and the name styled as `stats-card-name-link`. - Check that the drill-down renders well for a token, which no deck holds: - its card face and its figures (R4082000) show; - its deck-only sections show their empty states (`No games recorded with this card played.` and the like), not an error. - If the drill-down cannot show a token sensibly, open the card's inspect view, the `CardDetail` and its Statistics panel, instead. Say which one you chose in the ruling. ### 3. Remove the explanatory paragraphs Delete these blocks of prose. Keep error, empty and loading states (`The card statistics didn't load.`, `No games on patch … yet.`, `Details unavailable.`, the collecting-data notice of R3324000 and the like), headings, and the short `title` tooltips already on the headers. - **Cards tab, the tiers note** (`statsTestid.tiersNote`, R3022000): the three paragraphs ("Tier S is above … a nerf candidate…", "Read against {cards} cards…", "A card that is almost never left undrawn…"). - **Cards tab, the ranges note** (`statsTestid.rangesNote`, R2895000): "A range is where the card's true rate most likely sits…". - **Created sections** (`CreatedPanel`): the hint paragraph ("Tokens made during the game.", "Every other card made during the game…", "Win rate is of the seats that made one…") and `CreatedTiersNote`. - **Games panel** (`apps/web/src/stats/GamesPanel.tsx`): "Counted over {games} of the patch's {total} games…". - **Sets tab**: the intro ("How each set's cards do on patch {patch}…") and the footnote ("★ marks the highest win rate. ± is the margin…"). - **Players tab**: "Player stats are public by default. Ratings and ranks are not shown here." Remove their CSS (`stats-tiers-note`, `stats-sets-note`, `stats-games-note`, `stats-player-note` where nothing else uses it) and their test ids from `apps/web/src/stats/testids.ts`, and drop their strings from the translation catalogs if the web keeps any. ## Spec and tests Presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no rule, state, event, endpoint or response changes. - Add one ruling in this issue's block (`spec/rulings/R.md`, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/.md`). It amends every ruling that names a removed column or a removed note: at least R2089000, R2370000, R3184002 and R3324002 (columns and the hint), R3022000 (the tiers note), R2895000 (the ranges note) and R4082000. Grep `spec/rulings/` for the rest: the Sets tab's and the Games panel's notes, R1966000 and R1994000. - Update §9.11's text where it describes these columns or notes. - Proving tests named after the ruling (`it("R …")`), in `CreatedPanel.test.tsx` and `routes/stats.test.tsx`: - the Created tables' headers are exactly Card, Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted, Win rate, and the Columns toggle hides Card and Games in them; - clicking a Created row, or pressing Enter on it, opens the card (the drill-down and `?card=`); - none of the removed paragraphs renders. - Update the existing tests that assert the removed columns or notes, and any Cypress spec under `e2e/` that reads them (grep the test ids). - `cargo jackioh spec check` must pass. `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` must be green. ## Not in scope - The server, `GET /api/stats/cards`'s fields, and the dev tools' full Created tables (`stats-cards`, `stats report`). - #4083's sort select, Grid view, ranges and filters for the Created cards. - How Tier and Adjusted are computed (#4082). ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44219810815)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Make the `/stats` Tokens and Other created cards sections use the deck table's columns, order, labels, markup and row behavior (click/Enter opens the same drill-down and `?card=`), delete every explanatory paragraph listed in the issue (keeping error, empty, loading and collecting states), and record it all in ruling R4155000 with proving tests. Presentation only: no server, endpoint, response or tally changes. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/stats/CreatedPanel.tsx` | change | `CreatedColumn` shrinks to `name \| games \| tier \| adjusted \| winRate`; `figure()` drops the Used/Not used/Radiant/Normal/delta arms; new props `visibleThumbnail`, `visibleGames`, `onOpen`; thumb `Card` header plus `Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted, Win rate` headers; rows copy the deck table's cell markup and open the drill-down; hint paragraph, `CreatedTiersNote`, `pointsText` and the `field` prop go | | `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` | change | Pass `visibleCols.thumbnail/games` and `onOpen` into both `CreatedPanel`s; delete the tiers-note block, the ranges-note paragraph, the Sets intro and footnote, and the Players note; update header comments | | `apps/web/src/stats/GamesPanel.tsx` | change | Delete the `counted` paragraph; keep loading, error, few-games and figure lines | | `apps/web/src/stats/testids.ts` | change | Remove `createdTiersNote`, `tiersNote`, `rangesNote` | | `apps/web/src/routes/stats.css` | change | Remove `.stats-games-note`, `.stats-created-panel .stats-tr` (rows take the pointer now), `.stats-tiers-note p`, `.stats-player-note`, `.stats-sets-note` after confirming no other use | | `apps/web/src/stats/model.ts` | change | Remove `formatPlayedDelta` (only caller is `CreatedPanel`); keep `createdWinRate`, `faceRate`, `rateText` | | `apps/web/src/stats/CreatedPanel.test.tsx` | change | Rewrite for the new columns, sorting, toggles, row opening and absent notes | | `apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx` | change | Update Created expectations and replace removed-note assertions with absence checks; add row-opens-drill-down tests | | `apps/web/src/stats/GamesPanel.test.tsx` | change | The counted-note test becomes an absence check | | `apps/web/src/stats/model.test.ts` | change | Delete the `R377 formatPlayedDelta` block | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Delete the keys of every removed `t("…")` string | | `spec/rulings/R4155000.md` | new | The ruling (template: `spec/rulings/R4082000.md`; format: `spec/README.md`, "Adding a ruling") | | `spec/pending/4155.md` | new | Its §11 paragraph | | `spec/09-architecture.md` (§9.11) | change | Columns and notes text only | | Amended ruling notes (`R2089000`, `R2370000`, `R3184002`, `R3324002`, `R3022000`, `R2895000`, `R4082000`, `R1966000`, `R1994000`, plus any `grep` finds naming a removed note) | change | Append the `R4155000` amendment line and fix column/note wording; `R3324002`'s header list is the main one | | `e2e/` | none expected | Builder greps removed testids and strings; only touch if a hit appears | Do not touch: `crates/*`, `apps/edge`, dev-tools Created tables (`CardStatsBlock.tsx`, `stats-cards`, `stats report`), the API, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §9.11 and the rulings above. ## Steps 1. In `spec/rulings/`, confirm `R4155000.md` is still free (`ls spec/rulings/R4155*` empty). Write `spec/rulings/R4155000.md` (frontmatter `id`, `title`, `cards: "§9.11, …"`, `proven_in` listing the two proving test files) and `spec/pending/4155.md` (§11 paragraph). Ruling content: the Created tables show exactly Card (thumbnail), Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted, Win rate and sort like the deck table; rows call `openDrillDown(card.id, opener)`; the listed paragraphs are gone. State the choice: the drill-down, not the `CardDetail` inspect view, because catalog token defs render faces, `The Coin` (no catalog def) still shows figures with the existing empty-state strings, and no server change is needed. 2. `apps/web/src/stats/CreatedPanel.tsx`: shrink `CreatedColumn` to the five kept columns; delete the five removed `figure()` arms and the `formatPlayedDelta` import; delete the hint `

`, `CreatedTiersNote`, `pointsText`, and the `field` prop (and its `PublicCreatedTiers` import). Add props `visibleThumbnail: boolean`, `visibleGames: boolean`, `onOpen: (id: string, opener: HTMLElement) => void`. 3. Same file: rebuild the table on the deck table in `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx` (lines ~1015–1190) as the copy pattern. Header row: plain `Card` when `visibleThumbnail`, then sortable `SortHeader`s `Name` (ascending first), `Games`, `Tier`, `Adjusted`, `Win rate` (each `visibleGames` gating `Games`), keeping `aria-sort`, arrows, Enter/Space and `CREATED_DEFAULT_SORT` (`adjusted` desc). Rows: `` with the deck row's `role="button"`, `tabIndex`, `onClick`/`onKeyDown` calling `onOpen(card.id, e.currentTarget)`; cells copy deck markup and classes (`stats-td stats-td--thumb` badge with `data-rarity`, `stats-td--name` with `stats-card-name-link` or `plainCardOf`, `TierChip`, Adjusted `stats-winrate-cell` with confidence bar, Win rate `stats-winrate-text`). Keep Created floor semantics (`"—"` where it shows one today); do not add ranges or Play rate. 4. `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`: pass `visibleThumbnail={visibleCols.thumbnail} visibleGames={visibleCols.games} onOpen={(id, opener) => openDrillDown(id, opener)}` at both `CreatedPanel` call sites (do not add a thumbnail toggle button; honor the state value). Delete the `tiersNote` block (~L1192), the `rangesNote` paragraph (~L1222), the Sets intro (~L1282) and footnote (~L1431), and the Players note (~L1457). Update the file header comment's Created-cards sentence. 5. `apps/web/src/stats/GamesPanel.tsx`: delete the `counted` paragraph and the now-unused `counted` computation and `formatNumber` import if orphaned. `apps/web/src/stats/model.ts`: delete `formatPlayedDelta`. `apps/web/src/stats/testids.ts`: delete the three note ids. `apps/web/src/routes/stats.css`: delete the five rules in the table. `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: delete each removed string's key (first confirm in `i18n.test.ts` that it scans both directions). 6. Update the amended ruling notes and §9.11: fix `R3184002`'s header list, `R4082000`'s "each section's line" sentence, and §9.11's "sortable by any of its columns" and Games-panel count wording; append an `Amended by R4155000` line to each touched note. Grep `spec/rulings/` for `Tokens made`, `Tier S is above`, `A range is where`, `Counted over`, `How each set`, `★ marks`, `Player stats are public` to catch stragglers. 7. Update old tests: `CreatedPanel.test.tsx` header/sort expectations (thumb `Card` is a non-sortable `columnheader`; sortable indices shift; drop the Used-family sort cases), `routes/stats.test.tsx` `COLUMNS` and `cells` arrays (a thumb `td` with the cost now leads each row), `GamesPanel.test.tsx` counted test, `model.test.ts` delta block. Grep `e2e/` for the removed testids and paragraph strings. ## Tests - `apps/web/src/stats/CreatedPanel.test.tsx`, `it("R4155000 the Created tables show Card, Name, Games, Tier, Adjusted, Win rate")`: asserts the exact header texts in order and that `visibleThumbnail={false}` / `visibleGames={false}` hide those columns. `it("R4155000 a Created row opens the card")`: click and Enter call `onOpen` with the card id; headers still sort with Adjusted best-first by default. - `apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx`, `it("R4155000 a Created row opens the drill-down and ?card=")`: clicking a token row (and Enter on another) opens `drillDownModal`, shows its face and figures with `?card=` in the address; Games toggle hides `Games` in both Created tables; `it("R4155000 no explanatory paragraph renders")`: asserts absence of the tiers, ranges, Created-hint, Games-counted, Sets intro/footnote and Players strings. Run: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/CreatedPanel.test.tsx`, then `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/stats.test.tsx`, plus `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/stats/GamesPanel.test.tsx src/stats/model.test.ts src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`. - Then `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. ## Done when - Created tables show exactly the six deck columns with deck markup, honor the Columns toggle, sort every header, open on Adjusted best-first, and open the drill-down from click and Enter with `?card=`. - All seven removed paragraph groups are gone from page, CSS, testids and `zh-CN.json`; kept states still render. - Old tests updated; new `R4155000` tests fail without the change and pass with it. - `spec check`, typecheck, eslint and the touched web test files are green; §9.11 and every amended ruling note name the change. ## Risks - The deck Win-rate empty state reads "not enough games" while Created reads "—": keep Created's values and change only markup, or figures silently change. A token drill-down with empty `byTurn`/`coPlayed` must show the existing empty strings, not an error: cover The Coin and a catalog token in the route test. `visibleCols.thumbnail` has no toggle button today, so only the Games toggle is clickable; do not invent a button. ## Open questions None. Difficulty is medium: presentation-only, one app, about fifteen files. ```
